source: v3.0.0, lategoal rig/cards and unmodified late-experience bytes
sampler: lategoal.train.batch; reset numpy(seed+813) for each arm. Exactly the same ordered examples, cards, candidate optics and action labels from v3. Fixed final checkpoint. All scratch arms learn a probe. Only prediction-supervised arms use the optical target; action-only methods may ignore it. No external pretraining in this table.
task: Same physical rig, 24 train cards; 16 held-out goal cards. Paired success means both opposite goals solved after exactly the same observed probe. Spatial goal addresses, motor primitives, majority rule and observation frontend given, not learned segmentation.
analysis: Report original panel for comparability and new locked layout panel for replication, without new training data. 3000 paired layout bootstrap draws (seed 44178) keeping seeds and sibling conditions together. Primary: fresh paired task success and partial-minus-direct, partial-minus-world paired differences. No arm choice or tuning on either test. Estimate across fixed three seeds; not a CI over model population.
grouping: Secondary operational endpoint for every arm, same frozen ridge probe, independent calibration-only. Predict sign of four true camera lanes for the probed action; strict success requires all four correct and correct four-lane pattern in the other clutch of same wiring (8 signs). Compare history ablated to common unprobed view (zero optical change and image delta; keep real action/mark/gear). This measures intervention-dependent local co-motion, not masks, identity, or object permanence.
causal: Partial/detached: keep real history, direct route, goal and weights fixed. Independent calibration fits physics axes from reference actual optics and frozen optical decoder, legacy rank-4 rowspace and equal-length full-decoder-null control. Donor same wiring, other clutch; count native-correct and switch-to-donor on all changed-optimum goals D; null D0; native-correct and wrong on unchanged goals F. Partial mediation criterion: lower layout-CI for D-D0 and D-F >0, physical match >=0.80. Other unrelated architectures not forced into this adapter and reported NA, not zero.
transfer: Separate resource track: attempt official public pretrained SmolVLA (lerobot/smolvla_base, 5e8d12a6e2975b0e5e5fce7c8caf47c371d257b6) on the same stored observations/goals. Any use of outside weights, different adapter, sample/update/compute budget must be disclosed; never pool with scratch. No claim to rank unrun foundation models.
baseline: world: train action-conditioned future features, compare two candidate predicted outcomes with learned goal readout (one-step exhaustive MPC; not original V-JEPA/DINO-WM). token: goal-conditioned transformer predicts discrete action token (not OpenVLA weights). flow: conditional flow matching for signed action, deterministic zero initial noise in evaluation, not pi model weights. direct/detached are matched JSTP controls; archived v3 is historical only.
freeze: Commit protocol before training; store SHA-256s of exact dataset, weights and code. Seal signed choices before independent simulator calls; adjudicate actual camera outcomes. Completed, stopped or failed external track reported separately.
